audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] describe the wrong stages. Row 4 is Level 6 but whys[4] opens 'At 5 it evens out'; row 5 is First item but whys[5] talks about the level-6 Purgatory spike. Every reader of the chart gets the Purgatory explanation attached to the item row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors. (1) mid says Vault 'hops over you, resetting her Q for a second blind' — nothing in her kit resets Q; Vault dashes to the target, slows it, briefly interrupts it, and lands her back near her maximum attack range. (2) The page twice calls her disengage a knockback ('her E knockback', 'Skystrike knockback') — Skystrike only damages and re-marks with Harrier. (3) The blind is labelled onto Vault throughout ('Vault (Dash/Blind)') when the vision-hinder belongs to Blinding Assault (Q).
audit.why: The interrupt is the part that kills you: Ashen Pursuit teleports and then dashes to a target, and Vault briefly interrupts what it hits — so walking into her E mid-commit costs you the blink, not just the trade. And a player waiting for a knockback that never comes mis-times the only window they have.
audit.corrected: whys[2], mid, late, spikes[2].text, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now state Vault's 675 range / 12s, the slow-interrupt-reposition behaviour, and put the blind back on Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11s).

I corrected it where the sentence also carried mechanics (report[5], dosFull[0], breakdown.cooldowns); rewriting the focus label itself would touch a dozen strings for cosmetic gain and risks the mirror.
